title: Piano blues at home and his ten siblings
summary: He only liked playing blues on his mother's piano when she was out; his siblings played for fun and he is the last of ten.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you ever try to learn the piano? And your mother had a piano in the home.
Oh yeah. No, I used to sit there, sit to the piano, and the only thing I liked myself was how to play the blues. I played the blues.
Can you still play the blues on the piano?
Oh, I couldn't play them yet, but I know, been so long since I've heard the piano.
What did your father do when he heard you play the blues?
Oh, he had died. He had died. Yeah, my father died when I was young.
Did your mother like it when you played the blues?
I couldn't play when she wasn't home, you know.
What about your brothers and sisters? Did they play in any orchestras? Uh-uh. Did they ever work professionally as piano players?
No. No, they just could play, you know. And they used to go out to parties and dance, and they just played, you know, among themselves. They didn't play for a fact.
They were all Goldstones, they all had the same. All Goldstones. Full brother and sister. Full brother and sister.
There were ten of us. Full brother and sisters. And they all died out except me. I was on the last Goldstone.
